title: Yarr
descript: Yarr is a single-binary feed reader with a clean web UI: subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds, read them in a three-pane view, star and search items, and keep everything in one local SQLite database. It is tiny, needs no database server and stores nothing outside the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Yarr 2.9 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Lightweight RSS/Atom reader with local SQLite storage.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The UI listens on the published port; the SQLite database and cached feed content live in DockerAppData/yarrdocker/data. There is no built-in login, so keep it on your LAN or protect it with a reverse proxy. Plain HTTP.

zh-cn.descript: Yarr 是单二进制的 RSS 阅读器，界面干净：订阅 RSS/Atom、三栏阅读、收藏与搜索，所有内容都存在本地一个 SQLite 数据库里。体积极小、不需要数据库服务，也不在应用数据目录之外写任何东西。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。界面监听已发布端口；SQLite 数据库与缓存内容保存在 DockerAppData/yarrdocker/data。它没有内置登录，请只在内网使用，或用反向代理加一层保护。界面为纯 HTTP。

zh-hk.descript: Yarr 是單一二進位的 RSS 閱讀器，介面乾淨：訂閱 RSS/Atom、三欄閱讀、收藏與搜尋，所有內容都存在本地一個 SQLite 資料庫裡。體積極小、不需要資料庫服務，也不在應用資料目錄之外寫任何東西。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。介面監聽已發佈端口；SQLite 資料庫與快取內容保存在 DockerAppData/yarrdocker/data。它沒有內建登入，請只在內網使用，或用反向代理加一層保護。介面為純 HTTP。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Yarr 2.9，以非 root 容器運行。輕量 RSS/Atom 閱讀器，本地 SQLite 儲存。

data_notes: `/data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/yarrdocker/data`) holds `yarr.db` with feeds and read state.
design_notes: **Health check without HTTP tools.** The image ships no curl/wget/nc, so the check greps the listening port in `/proc/net/tcp6` (7070 = 0x1B9E).
**Runs as uid 1000.** One SQLite file on the mounted volume is all the state it has.
limitations: - No authentication; use a reverse proxy if it must be reachable from outside the LAN.
- The image has no shell utilities beyond `sh`/`grep`.
